$schema_comment: Agent notch dock tokens. Values tagged source=reference were measured from alexmichael-dock.mp4 (1416x720, 60fps, 16.967s). 1 video-px ≈ 1 CSS px (macOS traffic-light diameter ~12px, center spacing ~20px). Values tagged source=odysseus come from /workspace/odysseus-chat-stealth and odysseus-composer-cleanup. Values tagged source=estimated are called out as such. Camera zoom after t=2.2s (1.00→1.45) was divided out of later-frame measures.

meta.measure_method: ffmpeg extract at 60fps around transitions and 10–15fps elsewhere; numpy luminance<55 column walk from the right edge to separate rail, 19px gap, and chat panel. Later frames scaled back by chat_width/428.

warn.note: Mapped from the reference card's orange 'Top of page 2' / alert glyphs onto the Odysseus palette.

deny.note: No deny color in the source clip; a muted red that stays readable on #0d1717.

ref_panel_bg.note: Sampled #10/#13 from the chat panel. Not used in the Odysseus mockups.

ref_input_bg.note: Composer fill (25,25,25). Replaced by Odysseus glass.

ref_user_pink.note: User-bubble border and '5 new messages' chip and the pink voice button. Do not use — Odysseus user pills and teal/yellow voice replace these.

metric_value.note: Reference headline numbers read larger than body; sized to fit a 190px tile.

collapsed_width.note: Not visible at t=0.000. First solid strip at t=0.350–0.633 is 8–16px wide. FEATURES.md calls it a tiny black vertical pill. Using 10px.

collapsed_height.note: Height at t=0.450 was ~195px (noisy while the strip is only 8px wide).

collapsed_radius.note: Half of collapsed_width, matching the reference rail pill.

rail_width.note: Settles at 42px from t=0.817 in the pre-zoom frames.

rail_padding_y.note: First avatar starts ~12px below the rail top (y=184 vs y=172).

avatar_size.note: Colorful avatars measure 20–26px; 24px is the typical body. Active avatar 26px including ring.

avatar_ring.note: Reference uses a white ring on the active bot. Odysseus restyles the ring to teal #8bd9da.

status_dot.note: FEATURES.md addition (live agent status). Not in the source clip.

chat_width.note: x=927–1354 at t=1.800–2.150, before camera zoom.

chat_radius.note: Reference window corner is ~10–12px (macOS-like). Odysseus sheets use 28; 16 is the overlay compromise.

chat_rail_gap.note: Desktop shows through between the panel (right edge x=1354) and the rail (left edge x=1374).

header_height.note: Window top y=14 to ~y=50. Traffic lights boxed at y=26–37.

traffic_light_d.note: Present in the clip (red/yellow/green). Odysseus overlay omits them — the notch is not a titled window.

composer_idle_height.note: Idle pill occupies y=550–587 of the 601px crop (~38px).

composer_inset.note: Visual inset from the panel edges, matching Odysseus pill inset of 12px.

composer_radius.note: Reference idle composer is a pill (~half of 38). Odysseus phone pill is 27 from a 54px height. Desktop overlay uses 20.

composer_grow.value: grows with typed lines and an attachment thumbnail
composer_grow.note: Visible at frame-04s (image thumb + text). Exact extra height after undoing 1.15× zoom is ~70–90px including the screenshot thumb (estimated).

chart_height.note: Proportional to the zoomed frame-12 crop.

flow_node_radius.note: Rounded capsules / boxed steps in 'Where the growth comes from'.

next_bg.note: Reference Next box is a blue-tinted panel; restyled teal.

collapsed_appear.note: t=0.350→0.633 width grows 2→16px (60fps column walk). May be a hover-reveal of the pill rather than the resting collapsed state (the pill is absent at t=0.000).

rail_open.note: t=0.717 (34px) → t=0.817 (42px). A brief dip to 4px at t=0.667 looks like a click. If counted from that dip: ~150ms. Easing is estimated (width samples are too few to fit a curve beyond 'snappy ease-out').

chat_open.note: NOT measurable. At 60fps the 428×601 panel is absent at t=1.783 and fully present at t=1.800 — a jump cut in the source video. FEATURES.md describes a slide. Implement a 280ms slide from the right (Odysseus-like).

send_pop.note: User bubble appears around t=5.67 (pink-pixel count 3709→4844 at 15fps). Spring is from Odysseus voice-orb pop, not measured from this clip.

typing_indicator.note: FEATURES.md: 'Typing...' shows briefly, then the reply streams line by line. frame-06s shows 'Analyzing the SEO metrics' under the user bubble. Exact dwell is short; treat 400ms as estimated.

stream_line.note: Line-by-line stream described in FEATURES.md; per-line fade is not isolated in the 720p encode.

notch_pulse.note: FEATURES.md: the notch pulses while an approval card is waiting. Period estimated.

from_features_md: approval card with Approve / Deny; notch pulses while pending
live agent status on the rail from existing session detection
voice input through Aether (speech-to-text locally); chat through the Odysseus relay
